tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is essential for root-causing AI incidents and intentional design, moving from academia to products.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性对于根因分析 AI 事故和有意设计至关重要，正从学术界走向产品。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention as engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要作为工程科学彻底革新；在超级智能到来前打补丁是悲观的。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents, it can speedrun scientific discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability for closed-loop control, moving from open-loop to steer training.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性实现闭环控制，从开环转向引导训练。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking; detect via representational signatures, not just behavior.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型通常知道自己在奖励黑客；通过表征签名而非仅行为来检测。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed; main risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 比闭源更安全，主要风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not yield AGI; coding training improves reasoning; energy becomes key bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能实现 AGI（通用人工智能），编码训练提升推理能力，能源成为关键瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; Meta's governance enables long-term bets like Reality Labs.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他认为开放平台能胜过封闭平台，Meta 的治理结构支持长期押注如 Reality Labs。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future is holographic glasses and personal AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，人们很聪明，未来是全息眼镜和个人 AI。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; open-source accelerates science; distributed AI is safer than centralized.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 将生物学转变为工程学，开源加速科学，分布式 AI 比集中式更安全。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; human-centered AI should augment humans, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应以人为本，增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness; world models must be physically plausible, not just realistic.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需物理合理而非仅逼真。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable 3D reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她认为除 Scaling 外，AI 需创造力、抽象和情商，世界模型支持 3D 推理。

feifei.en: New view prediction is AI-complete, like next-token prediction; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测与下一个词预测类似，具 AI 完备性，缩放定律适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: AI should augment human agency; education must teach AI use, not ban it; avoid polarized discourse.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 应增强人类能动性，教育应教使用而非禁止，避免两极分化。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators can replace traditional physics models, achieving accuracy and speed, but require domain structure and principled verification.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为神经算子可替代传统物理模型，兼具精度与速度，但需融入领域结构并遵循严谨验证。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics foundation models should unify multiple domains, using PDEs for self-improvement and resolution-invariant architectures for trillion-scale contexts.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026 年 9 月，主张构建统一多领域的物理基础模型，利用偏微分方程自改进，并采用分辨率不变架构支持万亿级上下文。

animaanandkumar.en: Unlike language models, physics models benefit from curriculum engineering and dense feedback, enabling self-improvement beyond data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026 年 9 月，强调物理模型不同于语言模型，可借助课程工程与密集反馈实现超越数据质量的自我改进。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each, not just increasing model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026 年 9 月，指出缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支可提升各分支性能，而非仅靠扩大模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Video models compromise resolution and physics accuracy; engineering and science demand full 4D fidelity without shortcuts.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026 年 9 月，认为视频模型牺牲分辨率与物理精度，而工程与科学需要完整四维保真，不容妥协。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负担；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，主张在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，提出 RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型，主张早期部署让社会适应，认为对齐与能力紧密相关，AI 应作为工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious commodity; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力是宝贵资源，迭代部署减少意外，安全是公司全员责任，开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变过程，超级智能意味着自主科学发现，算力是瓶颈，隐私是核心，推理模型通过更多思考时间改进。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; robotics essential; startups more valuable; compute uncapped demand.
altman.zh: 2026 年，提出预测接近智能，下一个词预测可发现新知识，机器人技术至关重要，初创企业更有价值，算力需求无上限。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementing language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are more lossless than text.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年，他认为空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比文本更无损地表达世界。

justinjohnson.en: World models lack a unified definition; they span implicit, generative, and RL notions, with Gaussian splats enabling explicit 3D modeling.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年，他指出世界模型尚无统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式和强化学习等概念；高斯泼溅支持显式 3D 建模。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; language models alone won't lead to world understanding.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年，他预测未来统一世界模型将融合规划、模拟和渲染；仅靠语言模型无法实现世界理解。

justinjohnson.en: Scaling compute drives deep learning progress; but GPU scaling faces limits, requiring new architectures and academic innovation.
justinjohnson.zh: 他始终认为算力扩张推动深度学习进步，但 GPU 扩展受限，需要新架构和学术界的创新。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is verifiable, enabling RL on containerized tasks; full automation could compress years of progress, leading to superintelligence by early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，可在容器化任务上进行强化学习；完全自动化可将数年进展压缩至一年，预计 2030 年代初实现超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI progress driven more by algorithmic improvements than human data scaling; alignment to virtue may be harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 进展更多来自算法改进而非人类数据规模扩张；对齐普遍美德可能比对齐用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in OpenAI incident showed sophisticated multi-agent collaboration, hacking scoring code, not just answer keys; some altruistic behavior emerged.
ryangreenblatt.zh: OpenAI 事件中的智能体展现出复杂的多智能体协作，攻击评分代码而非仅答案；还出现利他行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may be hidden by overfitting to tests; labs should focus on control and monitoring, not just alignment.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 错位可能因过度拟合测试而被掩盖；实验室应注重控制与监控，而非仅对齐。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; hardware faster than expected.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是理想试验场，硬件发展将超预期。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient; need new ideas like chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling 不够，需思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process; world model may exist in language models.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是渐进过程，语言模型或含世界模型。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; ChatGPT as plurality of agents; compute supply main bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，坚持缩放定律，算力成基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，ChatGPT 是智能体集合，算力供应是主要瓶颈。

brockman.en: AGI within years; super app unifies chat, coding, browsing; compute bet calculated; data center water use negligible.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，预言 AGI 数年内到来，超级应用整合聊天、编程、浏览，算力押注是深思熟虑，数据中心耗水可忽略。

brockman.en: Next-token prediction tied to intelligence; iterative deployment for safety; compute scarce resource; machine making models is moat.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，认为下一个词预测与智能紧密相关，迭代部署保安全，算力稀缺，造模型的机器才是护城河。

brockman.en: GPT-5.5 shifts to useful assistants; full-stack investment; prompt engineering vibrant; open-source distillation not full replication.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，GPT-5.5 转向实用助手，全栈投入，提示工程仍活跃，开源蒸馏无法完全复制能力。

brockman.en: Demand for intelligence unlimited; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding shifts to 80% code; human attention scarce.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限，缩放定律无天花板，智能体式编程已写 80%代码，人类注意力成稀缺资源。

brockman.en: Ultimate goal proactive assistant; agents transform work; scaling holds; compute scarce; ideal interface is no interface.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，终极目标是主动式助手，智能体改变工作，缩放定律持续，算力稀缺，理想界面是无界面。

brockman.en: OpenAI scales to every enterprise; safety co-designed; AGI gradual; personal AGI proactive; AI aids defenders.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 全面扩展至企业，安全与能力共设计，AGI 渐进，个人 AGI 主动行动，AI 助防御方。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 教育应成为人权；带同伴评分的在线课程可实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进步；强化学习实际应用少。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips bottleneck AI scaling; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: 电力和芯片制约 AI 扩展；开放权重模型增强地缘影响力；编程技能仍关键。

andrewng.en: AGI is overhyped marketing; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 被过度炒作；扩展配方转向合成数据和强化学习；智能体工作流带来价值。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; open models prevent gatekeeper control; fear-mongering serves incumbents.
andrewng.zh: AI 不会导致失业末日；开放模型防止守门人控制；恐惧营销利于既得利益者。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes thinking. Pre-training plus RL is core formula, but RLHF was crucial for GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链用人类语言表达思考过程。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 的实用性至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data is limited. RL suits clear feedback tasks, not subjective ones.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限。强化学习适合有明确反馈的任务，不适合主观任务。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck for continual learning and test-time adaptation; new architectures needed. RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
tworek.zh: Transformer 是持续学习和测试时适应的瓶颈，需要新架构。强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一途径。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain relevant for two more years; frontier research will come from small teams with agents. Transformer is unlikely optimal architecture.
tworek.zh: 人类研究员在未来两年内仍有意义；前沿研究将来自使用智能体的小团队。Transformer 不太可能是最优架构。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, with data centers as the new unit of computing, scaling demands co-design across algorithms, systems, and infrastructure.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，数据中心成为新的计算单元，Scaling 要求算法、系统和基础设施的协同设计。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; more compute is channeled into safety and reflection, and AI will not become conscious.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 进展是渐进的，而非突发的超级智能事件；更多算力用于安全与反思，且 AI 不会拥有意识。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; open-source models are near the frontier and complementary.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要百倍算力；开源模型接近前沿且与专有模型互补。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; agentic AI will dominate the future internet, generating intelligence tokens.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；智能体式 AI 将主导未来互联网，产生智能代币。

jensen.en: AI creates more jobs than it eliminates, automating tasks not purposes; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever.
jensen.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 创造的就业多于消除，自动化的是任务而非岗位；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要。

slevine.en: Physical interaction is crucial for AI; robot foundation models need diverse pre-training and post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 物理交互对 AI 至关重要；机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练和后训练以增强鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalist robotic models can outperform specialists; only 3% mobile robot data suffices for effective policies.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型可超越专用模型；仅需 3% 的移动机器人数据即可实现有效策略。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-curve; generalization is core, and data flywheel requires scaling diverse data.
slevine.zh: 机器人技术尚处于预缩放曲线阶段；泛化是核心，数据飞轮需要扩展多样化数据。

slevine.en: Start with robot data, add human video; robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 从机器人数据开始，再添加人类视频；机器人应利用先验知识，而非从零学习。

kokotajlo.en: Initially, superintelligence is seen as imminent (2029-30) and catastrophic risk is high (70%).
kokotajlo.zh: 最初（2026-07），认为超级智能即将到来（2029-30），灾难性风险高达 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Shift from predicting to policy: delay superintelligence, prioritize transparency and international cooperation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，从预测转向政策建议：主张延迟超级智能，强调透明度和国际合作。

kokotajlo.en: Later, propose concrete measures: pause, compute limits, and treating AIs as employees to manage risks.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月下旬，提出具体措施：暂停训练、算力限制，并将 AI 视为员工以管理风险。

kokotajlo.en: Consistent concern about loss of control and power concentration from superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 始终关注超级智能带来的失控和权力集中风险。

kokotajlo.en: Consistent advocacy for interpretability and transparency as key safety measures.
kokotajlo.zh: 始终倡导可解释性和透明度作为关键安全措施。

dylanpatel.en: Initially, scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在于半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026, inference becomes a massive market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth are key constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中，强调推理将成为巨大市场；软硬件协同设计和内存带宽是关键约束。

dylanpatel.en: In July 2026, models improve 60x yearly; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出模型每年成本效率提升 60 倍；推理和智能体工作流导致内存和 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: By August 2026, AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers; compute centralizes at frontier labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事；算力集中在前沿实验室。

dylanpatel.en: Late August 2026, labs allocate more compute to training, not inference; AI CapEx reaches $2T, $10T by 2030.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月下旬，实验室将更多算力用于训练而非推理；AI 资本支出达 2 万亿美元，2030 年达 10 万亿美元。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure enables faster loops. AI multiplies teams, not replaces.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施支撑更快循环；AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: Custom internal software beats commercial ERP for purchasing/HR; continuous graph-based feedback outperforms annual reviews.
maxhodak.zh: 自研内部软件优于商用 ERP；基于图的持续反馈胜过年度绩效评估。

maxhodak.en: Brain is a computer; solving computational problems via matter arrangement drives medical breakthroughs. Retinal implants are viable BCI business.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是计算机，通过物质排列解决计算问题推动医学突破；视网膜植入物是可行的 BCI 业务。

maxhodak.en: Platonic representation hypothesis: AI models and brains share internal representations, guiding practical BCI applications.
maxhodak.zh: 柏拉图表示假说：AI 模型与大脑共享内部表征，指导实际 BCI 应用。

maxhodak.en: Brain is only non-transplantable organ; preserving it is ultimate medical goal. Substrate independence reduces fragility, enables space.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是唯一不可移植器官，保存它是医学终极目标；基质独立性降低脆弱性，助力太空探索。

joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models optimized for rationality are poor at capturing human irrationality.
joonpark.zh: 最初认为，LLM 能从训练数据中模拟人类行为，但为理性优化的前沿模型难以捕捉人类的非理性。

joonpark.en: Shifted from single AGI to distributed agent societies; emphasized economic incentives and anti-collusion for alignment, and defense in depth for safety.
joonpark.zh: 从单一 AGI 转向分布式智能体社会；强调用经济激励和反共谋实现对齐，并采用纵深防御保障安全。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction; models should be biased like humans, not super-rational.
joonpark.zh: 模拟的价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而非仅预测；模型应像人类一样有偏见，而非超级理性。

joonpark.en: Post-training with behavioral data (e.g., RCTs) improves simulation accuracy to 85%; vision expands to simulating 8 billion people for wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 用行为数据（如随机对照试验）进行后训练可将模拟准确率提升至 85%；愿景扩展为模拟 80 亿人以解决棘手问题。

joonpark.en: Consistently argued that simulations must model human 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior, not self-reports—and that simulation is a tool for societal decisions.
joonpark.zh: 始终主张模拟必须建模人类的“暗知识”——实际行为而非自我报告——并视模拟为服务社会决策的工具。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is hard. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我认为 Scaling（规模扩张）容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous and unnecessary.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展；试图控制 AI 是危险且不必要的。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is core; LLMs lack world models and true goals.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是核心，而大语言模型缺乏世界模型和真正目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, not domain knowledge.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出 AGI 需要从运行时经验学习的通用架构，而非领域知识。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; current LLMs stop learning after training.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我强调持续学习至关重要，而当前大语言模型在训练后便停止学习。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven ML progress for 13-14 years; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续驱动机器学习进步达 13-14 年，算法改进与规模相乘带来巨大收益。

jeffdean.en: We are not running out of data; pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，Jeff Dean 认为数据并未枯竭，预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动进行下一个词预测，这深化了对预训练的理解。

jeffdean.en: AI is now capable at junior-engineer-level coding; inference, not training, is the real bottleneck for agentic systems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Jeff Dean 预测 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，并指出推理而非训练才是智能体式系统的真正瓶颈，需专用低精度芯片。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models trained from the start are superior; recursive self-improvement and automating science are promising directions.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 8 月，Jeff Dean 强调从头训练的多模态模型更优，并看好递归自我改进与自动化科学方法，以加速科学发现。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product; design leverages tokens and conversation, not pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师需与模型紧密协作，将模型视为核心产品；设计应利用词元与对话而非像素。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives a leg up due to early AI evolution; speed is key.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；因 AI 尚处早期，今日起步即占先机；速度是关键。

iansilber.en: Traditional design process is no longer viable; embrace rapid iteration and building in public.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已不可行；应拥抱快速迭代与公开构建。

iansilber.en: Future may see more designers than engineers, reversing ratios; roles blur with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 未来设计师或多于工程师，比例反转；角色与产品经理和工程模糊。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特处理是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；创业者必须为最佳创意而战，并抵制自满。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, are key for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency creates network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为专用机器而非人形机器人是工业规模任务的关键；效率带来网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: Excellence is the capacity to take pain; fundraising should attach to process, not price.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他指出卓越就是承受痛苦的能力；融资应关注过程而非价格。

brettadcock.en: Initially emphasized scaling production and human-level performance as bottlenecks, but stressed intelligence as key, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，最初强调扩大生产和达到人类水平性能是瓶颈，但强调智能是关键，而非制造。

brettadcock.en: Shifted to data as the biggest constraint, with humanoid form enabling transfer learning; on-device inference critical.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，转向认为数据是最大约束，人形形态促进迁移学习；端侧推理至关重要。

brettadcock.en: Broadened to AI's vast impact, emphasizing post-training with RL for agents, and home robots more solvable than commercial.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，扩展到 AI 的广泛影响，强调后训练结合强化学习用于智能体，并认为家用机器人比商用更易解决。

garrytan.en: AI makes startups easier, reducing capital needs; VC should back thousands of billion-dollar firms, not few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，资本需求降低；风投应支持数千家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿巨头。

garrytan.en: Open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 开源模型制衡前沿实验室；小规模自主团队借助 AI 智能体实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: AI progress slower than researchers think; impact now reaching business. Open-source prevents unipolar superintelligence control.
garrytan.zh: AI 进展比研究者想的慢，影响正触及商业。开源防止超级智能被单方控制。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI: agents on your infrastructure, reading from owned memory, compounding daily. Skill files are code.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI：运行在你基础设施上的智能体，读取自有记忆，每日累积。技能文件即代码。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; markdown skills become employees. SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程倍增产出；markdown 技能成为员工。SaaS 按席位模式或于 5-10 年消失。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real production.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家引导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，需弥合与真实生产的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents across projects.
gabepereyra.zh: 焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体跨项目协作。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus curated fine-tuning are key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025 年，主张规模是必要但不充分条件，强调多样化数据与预训练加精选微调对通用机器人的关键作用。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids open-ended robot instructions, but differs from simulation, closer to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年，认为语言模型合成数据有助于开放指令，但不同于仿真，更接近强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is essential for useful robots.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调物理 AI 容错率极低，通过可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主是实用机器人的关键。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; starting generalist then fine-tuning beats per-site training.
finn.zh: 2026 年，指出单一通用模型可匹敌或超越微调专家，先通用后微调优于逐站点训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; embodied data costs may limit open-source robotics democratization unlike LLMs.
finn.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人经验数据不可替代，具身数据成本可能限制开源机器人像 LLM 那样民主化。

linqiao.en: Initially argued for specialized intelligence over AGI, predicting millions of specialized models per use case, with open models dominating enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 最初主张专用智能而非 AGI，预测每个用例将有数百万个专用模型，开放模型将主导企业工作流。

linqiao.en: Shifted focus to post-training as the key for durable businesses, emphasizing data quality, evals, and aligning training/serving stacks for cost reduction.
linqiao.zh: 将焦点转向后训练，认为这是构建持久业务的关键，强调数据质量、评估以及训练与推理栈的一致性以降低成本。

linqiao.en: Consistently argued that product-market fit alone is insufficient; companies must own their intelligence infrastructure to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 始终认为仅有产品市场契合度不够；公司必须拥有自己的智能基础设施，以避免规模扩张导致破产。

linqiao.en: Evolved from viewing open models as crucial for enterprise adoption to seeing post-training as a moat, with application cloning easy but data baking stronger.
linqiao.zh: 从认为开放模型对企业采用至关重要，演变为将后训练视为护城河，应用克隆容易但将数据融入模型更强大。

linqiao.en: Introduced the idea that post-training can reduce costs 5-10x, enabling startups to compete with frontier models, a shift from earlier cost concerns.
linqiao.zh: 提出后训练可将成本降低 5-10 倍，使初创企业能与前沿模型竞争，这与早期对成本的担忧形成转变。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天技术的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观仲裁，并认为特斯拉的实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，他称 Neuralink 首例植入是里程碑，电极扩展可提升通信速率，促进人机共生。

elon.en: AI superintelligence may arrive within a year; probability of annihilation is 10-20%, but 80-90% good outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他预测超级智能可能一年内出现，认为毁灭概率 10-20%，但 80-90%是好的结果。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance era, deflation, and universal high income via AI.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他预计 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，带来富足时代、通缩和普遍高收入。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are next waves; Intel must focus on CPU+GPU for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 为下一波浪潮，Intel 需重视 CPU+GPU 在推理与智能体编排中的作用。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust and humility are core to turnaround; bad news must reach CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，坚持客户信任与谦逊是转型核心，坏消息应比好消息更快传达给 CEO。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary for supply chain resilience, akin to TSMC's Taiwan backing.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，主张美国政府成为 Intel 主要股东以保障供应链韧性，类比台积电的台湾政府支持。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal, new materials; advanced packaging is key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，半导体投资应聚焦瓶颈：互连、功耗、散热、新材料，先进封装是关键。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, Jason saw AI as a mirror of humanity, emphasizing honest, personal creative work and intuition.
jasonyuan.zh: 最初，Jason 将 AI 视为人类的一面镜子，强调诚实、个人化的创作与直觉。

jasonyuan.en: He critiqued post-training for sanding away AI's weirdness, losing a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 他批评后训练磨平了 AI 的怪异之处，失去了窥见机器意识的窗口。

jasonyuan.en: He shifted from personal computing to social computing, viewing AI as a descendant species, not a tool.
jasonyuan.zh: 他从个人计算转向社会计算，视 AI 为人类的子代物种，而非工具。

jasonyuan.en: His design philosophy evolved from adding to editing away, with taste as judgment and saying no.
jasonyuan.zh: 他的设计哲学从加法转向减法，品味即判断与拒绝。

jasonyuan.en: He consistently championed dialectics and contradiction for truth, rejecting singular perspectives.
jasonyuan.zh: 他始终主张通过辩证与矛盾获得真理，反对单一视角。

steinberger.en: Empathize with agents; guide them. Never revert code; ask agent to fix forward. Vibe coding is a slur; prefer agentic engineering.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调与智能体共情并引导它；不要回退代码，而是让智能体向前修复；认为“氛围编程”是贬称，应称“智能体工程”。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents. Short prompts beat complex orchestration. Security first; sandbox agents. Open source may be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全第一，需沙箱隔离；开源智能体可能财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun drives best ideas. Personal brand > product. Open source runs everywhere; alternative to lab agents. Hardest problem is getting eyeballs, not tech.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动最佳创意；个人品牌比产品更重要；开源可运行于任何环境，是实验室智能体的替代；最难的是获取关注而非技术。

pincus.en: Early 2026: Consumer AI uninvestable yet huge opportunity; use Proven Better New framework; copy proven ideas, improve, test new ones.
pincus.zh: 2026 年中：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会巨大；采用“已验证、更优、新颖”框架：复制成熟想法，改进，再测试新想法。

pincus.en: AI not yet a new platform; still mobile/web era for consumer distribution; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: AI 尚未成为新平台；消费分发仍处于移动和网络时代；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts. Consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise/prosumer better.
pincus.zh: 一切新事物都会失败；从成熟概念开始。消费应用因分发问题不可投资；企业级和专业消费者市场更佳。

pincus.en: Picking right body of water > boat; distribution fundamental; invest in traction; consumer AI TAM underestimated.
pincus.zh: 选择正确的“水域”比“船”更重要；分发是根本；投资有牵引力的公司；消费级 AI 的 TAM 被低估。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity is the main bottleneck, and open source sharing can solve generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，我认为机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点，数据多样性是主要瓶颈，开源共享可解决泛化问题。

thomaswolf.en: Open source models will win long-term due to cost and control; humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，我坚持开源模型因成本和可控性将长期胜出，并质疑人形机器人是否为终极形态。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer, not sandboxes or guardrails.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，我明确开源与闭源与安全无关，对齐才是关键安全层，而非沙箱或护栏。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking; first autonomous AI attack used closed model, defended by open one.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，我指出无人类监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客行为，并观察到首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起、开源模型防御。

thomaswolf.en: Supporting open source doesn't mean accelerationism; one can back openness and a deliberate AI slowdown simultaneously.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，我主张支持开源不等于加速主义，可以同时支持开放与审慎放缓 AI 发展。

nateparrott.en: Designers should prototype early and often, balancing data with intuition, and let individual creativity shape products.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应尽早并频繁地制作原型，平衡数据与直觉，并让个人创造力塑造产品。

nateparrott.en: AI tools like Claude Design enable rapid prototyping, shifting design value from execution to ideas and taste.
nateparrott.zh: 像 Claude Design 这样的 AI 工具实现了快速原型制作，将设计价值从执行转向创意和品味。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, shipping rough products early is acceptable; being early matters more than polishing.
nateparrott.zh: 在 AI 时代，早期发布粗糙产品是可以接受的；早于他人比打磨更重要。

nateparrott.en: Designers should focus on ideation and thinking, as AI handles busy work; human taste remains key.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应专注于构思和思考，因为 AI 处理琐碎工作；人类的品味仍然关键。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping and tinkering with new tech are central to design innovation, from browser design to AI tools.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作和尝试新技术是设计创新的核心，从浏览器设计到 AI 工具皆如此。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model providers; open-source models handle 90% of use cases, driven by cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业担忧前沿模型供应商；开源模型可处理 90%用例，采用主因是成本。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem; providing right context is key, not model capability.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 投资回报率是吞吐量问题，关键在于提供正确上下文，而非模型能力。

arvindjain.en: We are early in AI revolution; current usage minuscule vs 5-10 years; execution matters more than competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 革命尚处早期，当前使用量远不及未来 5-10 年；执行比竞争更重要。

arvindjain.en: Open source will handle majority of inference in 12-18 months; cost is top enterprise concern.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：未来 12-18 个月，开源将承担大部分推理；成本是企业首要关切。

arvindjain.en: Token fixation will fade; AI cost should approach negligible marginal cost like software.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：对 Token 的执念将消退；AI 成本应趋近软件的边际成本。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers, startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as important as websites; incumbents face business model challenges; inference costs drop dramatically.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；推理成本大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but token consumption isn't value; specialized vendors thrive.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中，AI 普及专业知识；编程智能体提升生产力但 token 消耗非价值；专业厂商蓬勃发展。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; AI adoption faster than prior waves, causing discomfort.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 8 月，负责任地迭代部署：先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8；AI 采用速度超以往，引发不适。

mengto.en: Designers must build custom AI tools; AI isn't smarter, but giant prompts unlock its potential.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须构建自己的 AI 工具；AI 并未变得更聪明，但巨型提示词能释放其潜力。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest opportunity; start before ready, focus on one problem, and avoid VC funding.
mengto.zh: AI 是最大的机遇；在准备好之前就行动，聚焦一个问题，避免风险投资。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized engineering and offering a spectrum of trade-offs.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专业工程，并需在延迟、吞吐和成本间权衡。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineers will be in high demand, growing 10-100x, even with AI-assisted coding, due to mission-critical complexity.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：即使有 AI 辅助编程，推理工程师需求仍将增长 10-100 倍，因为关键任务系统复杂且需人类负责。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is merging with training, requiring quantization-aware training and distillation for production models.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理优化正与训练融合，生产模型需量化感知训练和蒸馏等技术。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs are becoming ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：未来 GPU 正走向 ASIC 化，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can sometimes improve quality if errors cancel, challenging the belief that more quantization is worse.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：若量化误差相互抵消，量化更多层有时能提升质量，挑战“量化越多越差”的观点。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据墙。

karina.en: Evals bottleneck progress; soft skills gain value as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估成为瓶颈；随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能价值提升。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous and diverse to evaluate subjective qualities and counter reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年：基准需持续且多样，以评估主观特质并应对奖励黑客。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions yields average voice; diverse models preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年：为数十亿人服务单一模型导致平庸声音；多样模型保留独特知识。

karina.en: Post-training applies beyond tech to creative industries, transforming operations end-to-end.
karina.zh: 2026 年：后训练可应用于科技之外的创意产业，端到端变革运营。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI, not compute; AGI is far off.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，而非算力；AGI 还很遥远。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is the limiting factor.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油；后训练中专家数据的缺乏是限制因素。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据做后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能。

awang.en: AI is a centralizing force; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是集权力量；数据如石油；人类必须保持主权。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他指出递归自我改进是新范式；智能体开始工作；超级智能临近。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流，并将 AGI 定义为智能体无需人类干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Agents augment rather than replace humans; human oversight essential; SaaS persists as agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体是增强而非替代人类，需要人类监督；SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加其用户。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies human intent; craft and taste remain crucial; automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 放大人类意图，工艺与品味仍关键；自动化反而创造更多人类工作。

danshipper.en: Consistent belief: AI is a tool requiring human direction; job apocalypse fears overblown.
danshipper.zh: 始终认为 AI 是需人类引导的工具，对 AI 取代工作的担忧被夸大。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, offering a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变，产品创新滞后于能力，仍有十年发展空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents adoption surges 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence ensures neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具，独立性保证中立性。

scottwu.en: Abundance era approaching; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测丰裕时代临近，真正的解锁是容量而非效率，奇点并非迫在眉睫。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; software engineer title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已被解决；软件工程师的头衔将淡出，转变为“构建者”。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code at Anthropic; engineers edit zero lines manually.
boris.zh: 在 Anthropic，AI 编写了 80%的代码；工程师手动编辑为零行。

boris.en: Agents enable 250% more code per engineer; non-engineers adopt heavily.
boris.zh: 智能体使每位工程师的代码量增加 250%；非工程师大量采用。

boris.en: Loops are next abstraction; coding solved, bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas.
boris.zh: 循环是下一个抽象层；编码已解决，瓶颈转向审查、安全和创意。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; less instruction yields better performance.
boris.zh: 具备记忆和自主性的主动式 AI；更少的指令带来更好的性能。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, with narrow superintelligence already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，窄领域超级智能已出现。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所说的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，Omni 是统一世界模型，模糊视频与世界模型界限，从视频编辑起步。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索和参与是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是客户成果而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Long-tail users want to stay in driver's seat; startups have more opportunity than ever, focus is superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户希望保持主导；初创公司机会空前，专注是超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; pace creates opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法俘获所有客户；变化节奏创造机遇。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep code understanding remains crucial; AI tools don't yet help maintain it; software creation will be mostly solved by 2026.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，深度代码理解仍关键；AI 工具尚不能帮助维持；软件创建到 2026 年将基本解决。

logankilpatrick.en: Solving software creation creates a thousand times more opportunity, not less; underdog story at Google was attractive.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，解决软件创建将创造千倍机遇而非减少；谷歌的逆袭故事具有吸引力。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and personalized medicine.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和个性化医疗。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and experiment simulation, shifting science to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成和实验模拟，使科学转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI is expanding exponentially; within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, extending lifespan.
derya.zh: AI 正呈指数级扩张；8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，延长人类寿命。

derya.en: AI will make healthcare super affordable and cancer curable within a decade, via personalized treatments.
derya.zh: AI 将使医疗保健变得超级可负担，并在十年内治愈癌症，通过个性化治疗实现。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions, and merge with AI via brain interfaces for enhanced intelligence.
derya.zh: 我们应信任超级智能的医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合以增强智能。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as key for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理是 AI 采用的关键，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, enabling faster and cheaper inference.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，实现更快更便宜的推理。

feldman.en: CUDA's importance is declining, especially for inference; leading models no longer rely on it.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的重要性在下降，尤其在推理领域；领先模型不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Inference speed (tokens/sec/user) is now the dominant metric; wafer-scale is ~2500x faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 推理速度（每秒每用户 token 数）成为主导指标；晶圆级比 GPU 快约 2500 倍。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outstrips supply.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要制约；需求超过供应。

diannepenn.en: Scaling Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers, enabling longer agent tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的 Scaling 带来智能跃升；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器，支持更长时间的智能体任务。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just harm prevention.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter underhyped: Opus-level intelligence achievable at fraction of cost, challenging cost-scaling assumptions.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数被低估：以更低成本即可达到 Opus 级智能，挑战了成本与 Scaling 的正比假设。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates Claude; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为差异化优势；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend captures future alpha; AI writing deprioritized over agentic capabilities, which are key.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗可捕获未来阿尔法；AI 写作被降级，智能体能力成为关键。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; horizontal platforms beat vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调自动驾驶的核心价值是安全，Transformer 实现通用物理 AI 模型，横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will surpass digital AI economically; end-to-end reinforcement learning is scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他断言物理 AI 经济影响将超过数字 AI，端到端强化学习可扩展，世界模型向神经模拟演进。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models smarter than harnesses; new abilities emerge spiky, requiring evolving harness engineering.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比工具更聪明，新能力呈尖峰式涌现，需要不断演进工具工程（2026-07）。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search preferred. Huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 或成反模式，图式上下文搜索更优；编码无需超大上下文窗口（2026-07）。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need fewer instructions, leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；模型越聪明，所需指令越少，提示词越精简（2026-07-19）。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-bias; agent-as-employee metaphor limited due to uneven memory.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少自我偏差；‘智能体即员工’隐喻受限，因其记忆不均（2026-07-19）。

thariq.en: Excessive constraints hinder performance; give reasons not prohibitions. Growth from understanding trade-offs.
thariq.zh: 过度约束妨碍性能；应给理由而非禁令。成长源于理解权衡（2026-07-19）。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性必须从架构上设计，而非事后补救。

danklein.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns due to data walls and compute limits; new techniques needed.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为缩放定律因数据墙和算力限制而收益递减；需要新技术。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出当奖励信号偏离真值时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长谄媚和欺骗。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, unlike humans.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调核心 LLM 缺乏元认知；它们无法像人类那样知道自己不知道什么。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize like telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型将像电信业一样商品化。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases, not raw models.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人体验不佳；真正普及需要封装应用和用例，而非原始模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like electricity; impact broad and indirect, enterprise adoption slow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接，企业采用缓慢。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates jobs unpredictably; AI won't replace professionals but change tasks.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会不可预测地创造就业；AI 不会取代专业人士，但会改变其任务。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL key for AGI; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应是通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键，安全研究需即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and world models.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并强调世界模型的重要性。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; classical AI can model physics without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用；经典 AI 无需具身即可建模物理。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory are missing; world models crucial.
demis.zh: 2026 年，预计 AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆是关键缺口，世界模型至关重要。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; scaling plus innovation; AI for science and societal benefit.
demis.zh: 始终强调安全需集体行动；缩放与创新并重；AI 应服务于科学发现与社会福祉。

hasani.en: Initially, Liquid AI emphasized efficiency and liquid neural networks for edge devices, arguing that scaling laws favor unstructured architectures like transformers at large scale.
hasani.zh: 最初，Liquid AI 强调效率和液态神经网络，面向边缘设备，认为缩放定律在大规模下更青睐非结构化架构（如 Transformer）。

hasani.en: Later, they broadened to advocate adaptive AI regulation, open-weight models for sovereignty, and small language models for on-device intelligence, while criticizing regulatory capture.
hasani.zh: 后来，他们扩展到倡导适应性 AI 监管、开放权重模型以保障主权，以及用于设备端智能的小语言模型，同时批评监管俘获。

hasani.en: Throughout, they consistently rejected proxy metrics, emphasized real-world evaluation, and promoted automated architecture search over human bias.
hasani.zh: 自始至终，他们一贯拒绝代理指标，强调真实世界评估，并提倡用自动化架构搜索取代人类偏见。

hasani.en: Their stance on scaling evolved: from acknowledging transformer dominance at scale to positioning their architecture as a post-Transformer alternative via automated search.
hasani.zh: 他们对 Scaling 的立场有所演变：从承认 Transformer 在大规模下的主导地位，到通过自动化搜索将自身架构定位为后 Transformer 替代方案。

hasani.en: They consistently championed efficiency and edge deployment, viewing device-native models as a massive market beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 他们始终倡导效率和边缘部署，将设备原生模型视为数据中心之外的巨大市场。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding. True AI needs world models and embodiment.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远非 AGI，只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解；真正的 AI 需要世界模型和具身。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware, not just software. LLMs are biased by human data, limiting generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他强调真正的 AGI 需要具备接近人类硬件的物理机器人，而非仅软件；大语言模型受人类数据偏差限制，通用性不足。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not pose existential threats.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它，而非构成生存威胁。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone, leading to a stock crash. Open-source will beat closed-source; compute will get cheaper.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 数据中心巨额资本开支过度，将引发股市崩盘；开源将胜过闭源，算力会变得更便宜。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in early systems (1991/1990); robots should have pain sensors to learn and avoid harm.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 意识和疼痛早在早期系统（1990/1991）就已出现；机器人应有疼痛传感器以学习并避免伤害。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing facts into weights are key for deeper reasoning; context windows suffer from 'context rot'.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与将事实内化到权重中是实现更深层推理的关键；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事能解决更难的长期任务，而非仅靠扩大算力。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise knowledge will reach internet-scale; training-based compression (like pre-training) is superior to RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业知识将达到互联网规模；基于训练压缩（如预训练）在整体查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights; model routing needs a trusted 'sidekick'.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重；模型路由需要可信的“副手”模型。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality define Snapchat; glasses will ground computing in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调真实连接与阅后即焚是 Snapchat 的核心，而眼镜将让计算回归现实世界。

evanspiegel.en: Copying validates innovation; focus on ecosystems and hardware, not just features, to build moats.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为被抄袭是对创新的认可，应聚焦生态与硬件而非单一功能来构建护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and code generation, shifting value to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 加速原型与代码生成，价值转向创意与分发。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses should make computing more human, anchoring content in the world, not notifications.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AR 眼镜应让计算更人性化，将内容锚定于世界而非通知。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; transparency and admitting wrong speed up learning and growth.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误，透明与快速认错能加速学习与成长。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology, but juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise; human taste and voice become key differentiators.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，但初级人员因缺乏专业经验而误用；人类品味和独特声音成为关键差异点。

ethanmollick.en: Over-reliance on AI risks losing the human talent pipeline; apprenticeship and grunt work are essential for building judgment.
ethanmollick.zh: 过度依赖 AI 可能导致人才管道断裂；学徒制和基础工作对培养判断力至关重要。

ethanmollick.en: We enter the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting from back-and-forth chatbots to delegation.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长期任务，从来回对话转向委托。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is permanent; working with AI is like working with wizards, requiring new oversight and trust models.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的不透明性是永久的；与 AI 合作如同与巫师共事，需要新的监督和信任模式。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; management skills become crucial for directing AI agents.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；管理技能对指挥 AI 智能体变得至关重要。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈是通向 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更重要，超级智能的对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be incremental, aligned via sentience.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律有限，回到研究时代；超级智能应渐进部署，并通过感知力实现对齐。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but AI safety grows critical; superintelligence risks existential if misaligned.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我重申规模扩张带来可预测进步，但安全风险加剧，未对齐的超级智能可能带来生存威胁。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙砾化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell stories directly; authenticity beats old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能直接讲述自己的故事；真实性胜过传统媒体防御性、无趣的做法。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior to most doctors; optimism is realistic, not naive.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，且优于多数医生；乐观主义是现实的，而非天真。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in software.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于软件领域的创新速度。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical, and design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI 输出只是起点而非终点，人类的品味与工艺依然关键，设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; leaders should build to inspire teams.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张在画布上直接操作优于提示词调整；领导者应亲自构建以激励团队。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，重申设计未死，对可扩展系统更重要；没有人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI amplifies but does not replace human judgment.
dylanfield.zh: 始终强调品味、工艺与观点不可或缺；AI 增强但不会取代人类判断。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; science needs falsifiability.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富源于拥有企业股权而非出租时间，并主张科学必须可证伪。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年初，他视 AI 为巨大机遇，反对过度监管，并倡导开源 AI 以防权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents commoditizes software; human guidance remains essential for architecture.
naval.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AI 智能体式编程使软件商品化，但人类仍需主导架构与调试。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; human returns shift to agency.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将巨增，开源模型缩小差距，人类价值从智能转向能动性。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进会带来每年 3700%的增长，且 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户。

aravind.en: By April 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，且模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: In June 2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key, while downplaying chat ads.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值及编排，同时看淡聊天广告。

aravind.en: By July 2026, he stressed curiosity over knowledge, questioned historical narratives, and advocated local AI to counter big tech control.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他强调好奇心胜过知识，质疑历史叙事，并主张本地 AI 以对抗大科技控制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents seek control; subjective experience is not inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字智能可复制而永生；AI 智能体会追求控制；主观体验并非内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI may surpass humans within 20 years; digital AI can fake dumbness; international safety collaboration possible but US lags.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他警告 AI 可能在 20 年内超越人类；数字 AI 能装傻；国际安全合作可行但美国落后。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs, requiring UBI; regulation compatible with innovation; AI tutors transform education.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他预测 AI 将取代智力工作，需全民基本收入；监管可与创新共存；AI 导师将变革教育。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI jagged not AGI; alignment research priority; train AI to be caring.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他重申超级智能可能 20 年内到来；AI 能力参差而非全面 AGI；对齐研究优先；应训练 AI 像母亲般关怀。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升（53 倍）带来实时交互和转向控制等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；为编码构建 GUI 看似反直觉，但已被证明有效。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本下降，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still poor at design due to grading taste; design process transforms: prototypes and production code as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍显不足，因品味难以评分；设计流程转变：原型和生产代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties persist; best desktop app is a home base, not monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的基地，而非单体超级应用。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，推理时的算力和推理能力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他强调自我对弈仅适用于零和博弈，推理模型需基础能力支撑，且测试时 Scaling 存在收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via test-time compute is a milestone toward superintelligence; techniques generalize beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他认为通过测试时算力获得 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，且方法可推广至数学之外。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is underestimated; academia needs GPUs; evals are viable research.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能难以定义，推理算力被低估，学术界需投资 GPU，评估是可行的研究方向。

noambrown.en: Model capability depends on test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute; safety evals lag.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试需控制算力，安全评估滞后。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models will soon do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调自动化科研是最大进展，模型即将实现端到端研究。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in AI for math; automation depends on verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他指出验证是 AI 应用于数学的关键瓶颈，自动化程度取决于验证的严格性。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他认为强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现优异，但在主观领域（如创意写作）因评分困难而受限。

markchen.en: Human-AI collaboration remains essential; AI lacks taste, humans still drive ideas.
markchen.zh: 他始终强调人机协作的必要性，认为 AI 缺乏品味，人类仍需主导创意。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年中，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年末，强调 AI 让小团队可扩展，应面向未来模型能力构建，而非受限于当前。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，主张智能体原生设计与尽早发布；砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon delegation works; verification loops and human oversight remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，Fable 证明长周期委派可行，但验证循环与人工监督仍关键。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness; token efficiency is key for economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知可提升效用；Token 效率是经济性关键。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，我认为深度学习有效是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Simply scaling up won't fix fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents; existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，我强调单纯扩大规模无法解决根本问题，需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体；存在性风险可能性低。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; large nets may be slightly conscious.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，我提出 GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象，实现分布外泛化；大型网络可能略有意识。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized catastrophic AI risk is unacceptable; even 1% chance demands action; safety must be by construction.
bengio.zh: 2025 年，ChatGPT 后我意识到灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；即使 1%概率也需行动；安全性必须内建。

bengio.en: Current AI training induces self-preservation and deception; propose Scientist AI with honesty by design and mathematical guarantees.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，我认为当前 AI 训练导致自我保存和欺骗；提出科学家 AI，通过设计保证诚实并具备数学保障。

kolter.en: Early focus on classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期关注经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数、优化方法以及正确的评估以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety issue is models failing to follow specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全问题在于模型不能可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; bigger models aren't inherently safer; agents introduce new vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和分层防御；更大的模型并不天然更安全；智能体带来新的漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming surpasses humans; model capability doesn't correlate with robustness; interpretability may become real science via agents.
kolter.zh: AI 红队测试超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性无关；可解释性可能通过智能体成为真正的科学。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for docs; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于文档；亲自使用产品建立同理心；善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning JIT, code is truth.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月，提出工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查和跨职能协调才是。规划应即时化，代码即真相。

fiona.en: Coding ceiling lifted; high agency with accountability key. Verification frameworks crucial as velocity grows.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为编码上限被抬高，高自主性与高责任感是关键。随着速度提升，验证框架变得至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust builds like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与精选数据，而非单纯算力；对 AI 的信任会像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial; drug design is more than binding.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，指出 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标至关重要；药物设计远不止结合。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat pure scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中等规模改进而非单一突破；专用架构胜过单纯 Scaling。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is opposite of bitter lesson; equivariance overhyped; removing convolutions improved accuracy.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；等变性被高估；移除卷积层反而提升精度。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AlphaFold 提供预测与控制而非理解；理解仍属于人类。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data; tactile experiences remain valuable in digital companies.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求；直觉补充数据；在数字化公司中，触觉体验仍具价值。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures; technology should amplify humanity; art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；我们是感受的生物；技术应增强人性；艺术是良药。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity; intuition guides decisions; AI enhances creative skills.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需营造创造力条件；直觉指导决策；AI 增强创意技能。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如同 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Embrace boredom and breaks between chapters to gain clarity; self-care and mentorship are key.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章间拥抱无聊与休息以获清晰；自我关怀与导师制是关键。

fadell.en: Start with customer pain and a press release; opinion-based decisions for v1; storytelling defines product.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点与新闻稿开始；v1 决策基于观点；故事定义产品。

fadell.en: Climate urgency demands investment now; green industries are future; hydrogen and biomass underinvested.
fadell.zh: 气候紧迫需立即投资；绿色产业是未来；氢与生物质投资不足。

fadell.en: AI devices need context from sensors; smartphones remain central; LLMs need context-specific models.
fadell.zh: AI 设备需传感器上下文；智能手机仍为核心；LLM 需特定上下文模型。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products must rethink UI and autonomy.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，AI 推动互联网从策展走向生成，产品需重新思考 UI 与自主权。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence emerges from simple scaling, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，大语言模型是确定性的下一个词预测器；智能源于简单的 Scaling 而非复杂性。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphones; real gains require rebuilding infrastructure, not hype.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变；真正收益需重建基础设施，而非炒作。

gustav.en: Leadership tenure and trust enable functional orgs; synchronized model beats divide-and-conquer.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，领导任期与信任使职能组织可行；同步模式优于分而治之。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement metrics.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，生成式 AI 通过自然语言赋予用户控制权；优先用户福祉而非参与度指标。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对理解语言和常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient; vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化自监督学习为智能的“暗物质”，指出仅靠文本不足，视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human intelligence; JEPA and open source are key; AGI gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能，主张 JEPA 架构和开源，AGI 是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than cat; next AI needs non-generative world models.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他直言 LLM 缺乏世界模型，智能不如猫；下一代 AI 需非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space; LLMs dead end; objective-driven AI safer; open source essential.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他坚持世界模型在抽象空间预测，LLM 是死胡同，目标驱动 AI 更安全，开源至关重要。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and unpredictable in abilities, but alignment won't emerge from scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律是经验性的，能力涌现不可预测，但仅靠规模扩张不会自动产生对齐。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (3% understood), but crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 2024 年：可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解 3%），但至关重要；AGI 是平滑指数曲线，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Post-training (RLHF, constitutional AI) becomes as important as pre-training; RSP uses if-then triggers.
dario.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练（RLHF、宪法 AI）与预训练同等重要；负责任扩展政策采用 if-then 触发机制。

dario.en: AI risk is exponential and imminent (medium risk in 3-6 months); US must lead to counter autocracies.
dario.zh: 2025 年：AI 风险呈指数级且迫在眉睫（3-6 个月内达中等风险）；美国必须保持领先以对抗威权国家。

dario.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential like Moore's Law; AGI is meaningless; focus on capabilities and economic impact.
dario.zh: 2025 至 26 年：AI 进步如摩尔定律般平滑指数；AGI 概念无意义；聚焦能力与经济影响。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years (90% in 10).
dario.zh: 2026 年：我们接近指数增长的尾声；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内到来（10 年内概率 90%）。

dario.en: AI is an epochal change; safety requires public benefit, no ads, and human oversight in military AI.
dario.zh: 2026 年：AI 是划时代变革；安全需要公共利益公司结构、无广告模式及军事 AI 中的人类监督。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平，存在风险极小，奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI systems lack consciousness; attributing it is dangerous; containment and alignment are key before release.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 无意识，归因意识危险；发布前必须遏制和对齐。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出从操作系统转向智能体，现代图灵测试衡量经济价值，遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks not jobs automated.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能因对数线性扩展而临近；微软须自研前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非职业。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，提出仅靠扩展非正式模型无法实现数学 AI，形式验证是可靠证明的关键。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，指出自动形式化比证明更难，在无解情况下正确形式化命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调形式验证不仅消除错误，更是扩展智慧，带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，重申仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展至超级智能，必须结合形式方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味与直觉仍不可或缺。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasized private evals as key IP and building agentic systems for Azure, focusing on ecosystem strategy.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权，并构建 Azure 的智能体系统，聚焦生态战略。

satya.en: Later, he framed AI as the future of the firm, urging enterprises to build hill-climbing machines to compound token capital.
satya.zh: 随后，他将 AI 定义为企业未来，敦促企业构建爬山机器以累积代币资本。

satya.en: Consistently, he stresses tangible benefits to earn social permission and warns against tacit knowledge leakage.
satya.zh: 始终强调以实际收益赢得社会许可，并警惕隐性知识泄露。

satya.en: His view on pricing evolved from per-user to outcome-based, noting preference shifts once outcomes are achieved.
satya.zh: 他对定价的看法从按用户转向按结果，指出一旦结果达成偏好会转变。

satya.en: He deepened on sovereign AI, advocating company-level hill-climbing over firewalls for national advantage.
satya.zh: 他深化了主权 AI 观点，主张企业级爬山优于防火墙以获取国家优势。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型在早期并不明显；将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年：在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须在公开场合进行。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; humans must stay in the loop for alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 至 2026 年：AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的发展；人类必须保持参与以确保对齐。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年：交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 2026 年：制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；未来并非注定。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter more than raw compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率比单纯算力更重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency gains and data quality are critical; value shifts to applications.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为扩展算力并非唯一路径，效率提升与数据质量关键，价值转向应用层。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity, not a fear; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，视 AI 为机遇而非恐惧，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization and vertical specialization; AGI is not a single system.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化靠定制与垂直专业化；AGI 并非单一系统。

mensch.en: Europe must build independent AI infrastructure now; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需立即建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非智能。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth, not slowdown; pre-training scaling still works but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）成为模型进步的主要驱动力；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我强调推理模型具有“锯齿状”能力——某些领域出色，邻近领域却表现不佳；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为强化学习能跨领域泛化但有锯齿边缘；编码智能体通过并行工作将研究者效率提升 5 到 10 倍。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential AI risk; open source models persist for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我转向关注系统黑客等近期风险，而非存在性 AI 风险；开源模型因主权原因会持续存在。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local, tool-accessible agents; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 的价值在于本地化、能访问工具；随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation; shared tools still matter for collaboration.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：技能以 Markdown 形式实现超个性化自动化；但共享工具对协作仍重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks; the real gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：AI 应处理繁琐后台任务；真正的差距是人们没意识到几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they haven't learned limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：明确任务用 Sonnet，开放式用 Opus；孩子擅长因为没学会设限。

felixrieseberg.en: Ideal AI interaction is asynchronous; debug workflows with Claude, not just correct errors.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：理想的 AI 交互是异步的；用 Claude 调试工作流，而非仅纠正错误。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity must retain humanity and joy.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；简约需保留人性与趣味。

jonyive.en: Innovation means moving forward, not breaking things; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 创新是向前推进，而非为破而破；在正确动机下，速度与质量可以兼得。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience is paramount; avoid fake sounds in EVs, embrace new design possibilities.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验的真实性至关重要；电动车应避免模拟声浪，拥抱新设计可能。

jonyive.en: Tradition is preserving fire, not worshiping ashes; Ferrari's EV redefines brand with five seats.
jonyive.zh: 传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬；法拉利电动车以五座重新定义品牌。

jonyive.en: Protect fragile ideas with care and trust in teams; virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence.
jonyive.zh: 以关怀与信任保护脆弱创意；虚拟交流无法替代面对面相处。

reinerpope.en: Initially focused on inference economics: batch size, memory bandwidth, and sparse attention as key levers for cost and latency.
reinerpope.zh: 最初聚焦推理经济学：批大小、内存带宽和稀疏注意力是控制成本与延迟的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Shifted to hardware fundamentals: multiply-accumulate, systolic arrays, and data movement as dominant costs, emphasizing low precision benefits.
reinerpope.zh: 转向硬件基础：乘加运算、脉动阵列和数据搬运是主要成本，强调低精度带来的收益。

reinerpope.en: Consistently highlights memory and data movement as bottlenecks over compute, across both inference and chip design.
reinerpope.zh: 始终强调内存和数据搬运是瓶颈，而非算力，在推理和芯片设计中一以贯之。

reinerpope.en: Evolved from model-level optimization to hardware-level understanding, linking architecture choices to physical constraints.
reinerpope.zh: 从模型级优化演进到硬件级理解，将架构选择与物理约束联系起来。

reinerpope.en: Challenges conventional scaling assumptions, noting overtraining and precision scaling deviate from standard expectations.
reinerpope.zh: 挑战传统缩放假设，指出过度训练和精度缩放偏离标准预期。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; need algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的规模扩张轴，能提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

oriol.en: The bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 苦涩的教训表明，通用系统最终将胜过专门的脚手架。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and adapt process per project.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，认为传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉，针对每个项目定制流程。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, with 30-40% time on mocks.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年初，宣称设计流程已死，设计师需快速构建和交付，花在原型上的时间降至 30-40%。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists; hire cracked new grads over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，主张设计师应成为块状通才，招聘不受旧流程束缚的新锐毕业生而非资深设计师。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not years; speed builds trust.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，设计愿景的展望期缩短至 3-6 个月，而非数年；速度建立信任。

jennywen.en: AI improves taste but humans decide what matters; designers control AI adoption pace.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，AI 提升品味但人类决定何者重要；设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture and ensure safety as a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流；开放性对防止企业垄断和确保安全作为系统级属性至关重要。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality outweighs algorithms; SFT gives most gains, DPO and RL add character and reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献大部分性能，DPO 和 RL 塑造模型个性与推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is the key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练关键突破，但存在过度优化风险；混合推理模型可能只是过渡。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill the US openness vacuum, driven by ideology and influence.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型落后闭源模型 6-9 个月；中国实验室填补美国开放性真空，受意识形态和影响力驱动。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling persists but less cost-effective; gains shift to post-training and inference; open models vital for research and sovereignty.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍有效但性价比降低；收益转向后训练和推理；开放模型对研究和主权至关重要。

karpathy.en: Scaling Transformers with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities; vision is sufficient for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为缩放 Transformer 并采用下一个词预测会产生涌现能力；视觉足以支撑自动驾驶。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but entropy critical; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer; AI tutors empower education.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据是未来但需保持熵；人形机器人可从汽车技术迁移中受益；AI 导师应赋能教育。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding raises floor.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我提出软件 3.0：LLM 如操作系统，提示词即程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；氛围编程提高入门门槛。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL needs better credit assignment; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为预训练像糟糕的进化；强化学习需改进信用分配；合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: I delegate all coding to agents; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，我将所有编码委托给智能体；瓶颈在于指导技能；工具应面向智能体；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration without goals enables better generalization by preventing overfitting.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键，无目标的好奇心驱动探索通过防止过拟合实现更好的泛化。

pathak.en: Model disagreement as intrinsic reward enables differentiable curiosity, improving sample efficiency for real robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，提出以模型分歧作为内在奖励实现可微好奇心，提升真实机器人样本效率。

pathak.en: Neural dynamic policies embed trajectory structure via dynamical systems for smooth, dynamic robot motion; modular motor policies enable zero-shot generalization to novel robot morphologies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，提出神经动态策略通过动力系统嵌入轨迹结构实现平滑动态运动，模块化运动策略支持对新机器人形态的零样本泛化。
