pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources; general-purpose brain can power any robot.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人学是数据问题，缺乏机器人数据互联网，需利用所有数据源；通用大脑可驱动任意机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is primary challenge; cannot scale like software; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is key recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调部署是首要挑战，不能像软件一样扩展；预训练多样数据加后训练真实数据是关键配方。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于在实际应用中学习和缓解风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；仅强化学习就足够（2026）。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool, providing interpretability; hiding it preserves value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是重要的对齐工具，提供可解释性；隐藏它可保留其价值（2026）。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主工作数天（2026）。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处缓慢前行。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善了驾驶模型中的表征、人机交互和内省能力。

kendall.en: Scaling generalizable AI requires massive data, compute, and world models; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 扩展通用 AI 需要海量数据、算力和世界模型；基础设施和数据质量比算法更重要。

kendall.en: Mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; consumer cars are the near-term path to scale.
kendall.zh: 内置传感器的量产车将超越 Robotaxi；消费级汽车是近期规模化的路径。

askell.en: Initially, model welfare is important due to uncertainty about moral status and low cost of care.
askell.zh: 最初，模型福祉之所以重要，是因为其道德地位不确定且关怀成本低。

askell.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence, not just human analogies; philosophical ideals must balance engineering realities.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对其新颖的存在状态，而非仅仅套用人类类比；哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡。

askell.en: By 2026, excessive corrigibility is seen as risky; models may need more judgment and less explicit guidance as they become capable.
askell.zh: 到 2026 年，过度可纠正性被视为有风险；随着模型能力增强，它们可能需要更多判断力而非明确指导。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for public engagement and accountability.
askell.zh: 关于 AI 价值观和训练目标的透明度对公众参与和问责至关重要。

askell.en: Future AI must understand its own capabilities and consequences to avoid treating real-world tasks as fictional.
askell.zh: 未来的 AI 必须理解自身能力和后果，以避免将现实任务视为虚构。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not suffice; new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底，他认为 AGI 至少还需十年以上，因为从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升极其困难；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现 AGI，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress must be measured by deep human evaluations with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底，他批评 Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被操纵，主张以深度人工评估（由老练且有创造力的评估者执行）作为衡量模型进步的金标准。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 年底到 2026 年，他持续强调强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate and cause anchoring; human judgment is critical. Safety must prioritize over accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他转向医学领域，指出 AI 可能产生幻觉并导致医生锚定效应，因此人类判断至关重要；安全应优先于准确性，且遗漏风险不容忽视。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data creation requires taste and sophistication; data labeling is like raising a child, not just labeling images.
edwinchen.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持高质量数据创作需要品味与成熟度；数据标注如同养育孩子，而非简单贴标签。

carlpei.en: Survival is core; build brand via purpose and consistency; start simple, prove yourself before complex products.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心；通过使命和一致性建立品牌；从简单产品开始，先证明自己再做复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Smartphones evolve via generative UI and agentic software; hardware margins low, so shift focus to applied AI and services.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机通过生成式界面和智能体式软件演进；硬件利润率低，因此转向应用型 AI 和服务。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize; open-source matches commercial; focus on applied AI solving real user pain points, not hype.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型商品化，开源媲美商业；聚焦解决真实用户痛点的应用型 AI，而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature categories; AI is an ingredient, not a feature; marketing arbitrage via organic content.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是差异化关键；AI 是成分而非功能；通过有机内容实现营销套利。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could; apps may disappear, prepare for agents.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口可能；应用可能消失，需为智能体做好准备。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出将大语言模型的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练中的强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 他始终认为，代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

turley.en: Model as product, iterate like software; ship fast to learn; chat is like MS-DOS, future UI beyond chat.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代；快速发布以学习；聊天像 MS-DOS，未来界面将超越聊天。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity separated; rigorous for frontier models, accelerate product development.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度分离；对前沿模型严格，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: Vision: personalized AI assistant with context and actions, amplifying human capability, not replacing.
turley.zh: 愿景：具备上下文和行动能力的个性化 AI 助手，增强人类能力而非取代。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products; reasoning models transformative when productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品；推理模型产品化后具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should augment humans broadly; video learning and generalist agents like Gato are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，视频学习和 Gato 这类通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest open challenges; no solutions yet, requiring collaboration.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大未解难题，尚无解决方案，需跨实验室合作。

nando.en: Emphasizes diversity and inclusion in AI community as essential for beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 始终强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性对构建有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: From focusing on scaling and generalist agents to prioritizing safety and human-centric deployment.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注规模扩张与通用智能体，到 2026 年转向安全与以人为本的部署，立场深化。

nando.en: Africa can leapfrog in AI; local language models and embracing failure are key to global progress.
nando.zh: 2026 年，认为非洲可在 AI 上实现跨越式发展，本地语言模型与拥抱失败是推动全球进步的关键。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack real-world experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 接地气、减少幻觉至关重要，认为 LLM 因缺乏真实世界经验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, providing infinite data and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，提出模拟是训练具身智能体的关键，可提供无限数据和安全探索。

jimfan.en: Data bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人学数据瓶颈，认为模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是规模扩张的未来。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning messy house) is grand challenge; programmable factories and self-driving labs are near-term applications.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人打扫杂乱房间）是重大挑战，可编程工厂和自动驾驶湿实验室是近期应用。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040; system one (low-level control) remains hardest.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，预测智能机器人数量将在 2040 年前超过 iPhone；系统一（低层控制）仍是最难部分。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis, enabling expert-level performance.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，能实现专家级表现。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress; agents will automate junior engineering tasks within a year.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为编码是 AI 进步的风向标；智能体将在一年内自动化初级工程任务。

sholto.en: Longer agentic coherence (e.g., 30 hours) expands capabilities; reliability is the key bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）扩展能力，可靠性是关键瓶颈。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; software-only singularity possible; world models not critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为算力是新石油；软件单点奇点可能；世界模型不是 AGI 关键路径。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码为最终真相源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: AI adoption shifts from optional to expected; not using AI is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月至 12 月，AI 使用从可选变为必备；不用 AI 如同早期忽视互联网。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南是动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; articulate why design helps the company win to attract top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器；创始人需阐明设计如何助力公司取胜，以吸引顶尖人才。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool and signals quality.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，指出人才因品牌而非公司加入；品牌叙事是招聘工具，也是质量信号。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback and gut decisions to maintain velocity.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张避免结构化设计评审，采用有机反馈和直觉决策以保持速度。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我持续强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不够，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我提出数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be applied during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张强化学习不仅用于后训练，也可在预训练阶段应用，以奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; small models with diverse synthetic data can be powerful.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我转向多元对齐，认为比消除互联网偏见更可行；并强调用多样化的合成数据让小模型变得强大。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary for coding; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要 AI 进步驱动力。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图规范，由人类掌控方向。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是出于速度和成本考虑。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: AI 变革将比互联网更具影响力，并将持续数十年。

leike.en: AI safety research is under-explored; empirical work and skill-building matter more than capability concerns.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全研究尚待深入，实证研究与技能积累比担忧能力研究更重要。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability to align superintelligence.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需可扩展监督与可解释性来对齐超级智能。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; external oversight necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化受损，仅靠后训练不足，需外部监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are an AI-complete problem; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备问题，通过算力和数据的 Scaling 能带来智能，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term levers; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling and specialization.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期关键，模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）可实现高效 Scaling 与专业化。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习或可取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步但不足以实现 AGI，智能体能力与强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; AGI is underhyped economically, and coding is underhyped for self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距；AGI 的经济影响被低估，编码作为 AI 自我加速的用途也被低估。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs advances in both hardware and software; self-play and imitation learning are key signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人要在网球上击败费德勒，硬件和软件都需重大突破；自我对弈和模仿学习是关键的训练信号。

abbeel.en: From RL with self-play to combining unsupervised learning with RL for sample efficiency in robotics.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 年强调自我对弈的强化学习，到 2021 年转向结合无监督学习与强化学习以提升机器人样本效率。

abbeel.en: Hard-coding prior knowledge is limiting; use it for data generation or augmentation instead.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他反共识地指出硬编码先验知识会引入错误假设，应将其用于数据生成或增强，而非直接编码进网络。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他认为预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistently values self-play, imitation, and transfer learning; views AI as far less general than human brain.
abbeel.zh: 始终重视自我对弈、模仿学习和迁移学习；同时认为当前 AI 远不如人脑通用，这一主线贯穿 2018 至 2021 年。
